datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Kenya to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were collected in multiple scenarios and compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML datasets for 2022, representing the spatial distribution of food insecurity severity.
